welcome.title: Welcome to AgentSync
welcome.body: Keep files and folders in sync across places and computers.

rules.title: Rules
rules.body: A rule copies one file or folder to several places, each with its own name.

locations.title: Locations
locations.body: Name your folders once per PC. Rules use those names.

sync.title: Sync
sync.body: Sync applies changes and uploads them. Backups are made first.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.body: Follow shared repositories and bring only what you need.

done.title: All set
done.body: You can replay this tutorial in Settings.
